title: Some / Any / No / Every
summary: Use some, any, no and every to talk about indefinite people and things.

explanation.en: Some is common in positive sentences, any in questions and negatives, no means zero, and every means all members of a group.
explanation.ru: Some обычно используется в утверждениях, any — в вопросах и отрицаниях, no означает отсутствие, every — каждый элемент группы.

commonMistakes.note: Standard English normally avoids a double negative.
Use some in most positive statements.
